system.longDesc:
These drugs help users to deal with (or at least shrug off) mental and psychological distractions, providing a +1 bonus to Willpower tests for 24 hours. A double-dose increases the bonus to +2, but imposes a –1 penalty to Intelligence tests, as the subject becomes quite single-minded. After a dosage wears off, the subject has a penalty to Willpower tests equal to the bonus they had for eight hours (unless they take another focus dose).

Resources TN 8.
